versions.name: Trust and Transparency
versions.goal: Build user trust by ensuring clear subscription terms, easy cancellation, and a transparent free tier.
versions.rationale: Both requirements address user trust and transparency around monetization. REQ-001 ensures a clear free tier, and REQ-002 ensures transparent subscription terms and easy cancellation. Together they address the core complaints about paywalls and billing issues.
risks: Potential revenue impact if free tier is too generous
Potential for increased cancellations if process is too easy
success_metrics: Reduction in negative reviews mentioning paywall restrictions
Increase in user retention for free users

versions.name: Content Quality and User Respect
versions.goal: Improve content quality and user respect by ensuring human-curated workouts, non-intrusive ads, and respectful imagery.
versions.rationale: These requirements focus on the user experience beyond monetization. REQ-003 ensures high-quality workout content, REQ-004 ensures non-intrusive ads, and REQ-006 ensures respectful imagery. Together they address complaints about AI-generated content, disruptive ads, and objectifying imagery.
risks: Potential increase in production costs if more human curation is needed
Potential reduction in ad revenue if ads are less intrusive
Potential need for new creative assets
success_metrics: Reduction in negative reviews mentioning AI content or quality decline
Increase in user engagement with workout content
Reduction in negative reviews mentioning ads or redirects
Reduction in negative reviews about imagery
Increase in positive sentiment regarding brand values

versions.name: Personalization and Consistency
versions.goal: Respect user preferences and maintain consistent workout plans to enhance personalization.
versions.rationale: This requirement addresses user preferences and plan consistency, which is a distinct theme from content quality and monetization. It ensures the app honors user choices and maintains plan settings, improving user satisfaction.
success_metrics: Reduction in negative reviews about customization issues
Increase in user satisfaction with workout relevance
